databases.title: Chinook music store
databases.description: The Chinook sample database: a digital music store with artists, albums, tracks, playlists, customers, employees and invoices. Read-only, served from a pinned copy of the upstream SQLite fixture. Its recordsets and fields carry the meanings of the chinook meaning graph.

databases.title: Northwind small-business sample database
databases.description: The classic Northwind sample database for customers, orders, products, suppliers, shippers, territories and employees. The pinned SQLite build is read-only; the native schema includes 13 tables and 17 views.
